capabilities: Format selected JSON or JSON code blocks with configurable indentation
Minify selected text or the code block under the cursor
Parse lenient JSONC and JSON5 syntax including comments and unquoted keys
Report syntax errors with line and column numbers
extras: Docs note the plugin is under 60 KB, has no native Node dependencies, and works on mobile; no screenshots or usage examples are included.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to format, minify, or validate JSON payloads inside notes and code blocks.
summary: JSON formatter and minifier that formats, minifies, and sorts JSON, JSONC, and JSON5 in selections and fenced code blocks.
